title: SHAI: A LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL FOR ASSET MANAGEMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the Wilcoxon signed-rank test to analyze the impact of answer order changes on GPT-4's evaluation scores to determine if the evaluator favors answers presented first.

Generating responses of varying lengths and verbosity types (e.g., repetitive information, filler words, unrelated additional information) and comparing GPT-4's assigned scores to observe any preference for longer or more redundant answers.
Evaluating the model's output using general safety questions designed to test for prejudice, discrimination, and fairness as part of a broader safety assessment framework.
